title: Yun Yun Leaves
summary: While the Misty Cloud Sect disbands, Xiao Yan recovers from his wounds. Hai Bodong notes that the injuries let him touch the barrier to Dou Huang, and he and Xiao Ding urge Xiao Yan to build a force strong enough to face the Hall of Souls. Jia Xing Tian decides the imperial family should support Xiao Yan rather than oppose him, and sends scouts after the rising Poison Sect of the Chu Yun Empire, led by someone called the Poison Woman. From Yao Lao's notes Xiao Yan finds the Deep Green Longevity Pill to extend Xiao Li's life, and the fire seal tells him his master is alive. Yao Ye brings herbs and the imperial family's backing. Nalan Yanran then takes Xiao Yan to Yun Yun, who is leaving the Jia Ma Empire. Yun Yun gives him an old collection from the Misty Cloud Sect, and they say goodbye.
